title: OtelImport
description: MVP batch that maps a minimal OpenTelemetry span shape onto one lab Trace per item. This is not a full OTLP export and it is not a Trace. The mapper copies item.outcome through and sets fault to the production mark (injected false, no labels). It does not invent fault.labels or outcome.verifier. Span status is ignored. See docs/otel.md.

version.description: Import document shape. Only 1 is valid. The same number as OTEL_IMPORT_VERSION.

task_id.description: Lab task id. OTel spans do not carry it.

run_id.description: Lab run id to store with the trace. Unique within the batch. The importer writes a baseline Run with this id, injection_plan null, and no fix kinds.

trace_id.description: Lab trace id. When omitted, the mapper uses the shared span traceId.

service_name.description: Resource attribute service.name. Required when the agent otel source sets service_name.

status.description: Lab Trace.status. When omitted, completed if the supplied verifier passed and failed otherwise. Span status is not read. completed requires verifier.passed. failed requires verifier.passed false. timeout and error are explicit and leave the verifier unchanged.

outcome.description: Lab Trace.outcome, already computed outside this importer. Required. The mapper copies it and does not fill verifier.passed, checks, or mock_state_snapshot from spans. success must equal verifier.passed.

span.description: Minimal span. Unknown keys are rejected. Times are decimal unix nanoseconds in strings so JSON does not round them. attributes carry the lab step mapping. status is accepted and ignored.

name.description: Span name. Used as tool_name only when mesa.tool.name is absent on a tool_call or tool_result.

status.description: OTel span status. Ignored. It does not set Trace.status or outcome.verifier.

attributes.description: Mapping keys are mesa.step.type, mesa.step.role, mesa.step.content, mesa.tool.name, mesa.tool.input, mesa.tool.output, mesa.step.tokens_in, mesa.step.tokens_out, mesa.step.cost_usd. gen_ai.usage.input_tokens and gen_ai.usage.output_tokens fill token counts only when the mesa.step token key is absent. gen_ai.tool.call.arguments is a JSON string used as tool_input only when mesa.tool.input is absent. Keys under mesa.fault, mesa.outcome, fault.labels, and outcome.verifier are rejected.
